Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes in this pull request.
请简要概述此 Pull Request 所做的修改。
この Pull Request で加えられた変更の概要を記載してください。

## Related Issue / 关联问题 / 関連 Issue

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change / 改动类别 / 変更の種類

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue) / 缺陷修复
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality) / 新功能
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change) / 破坏性变更
- [ ] Documentation update / 文档更新
- [ ] Localization improvement / 本地化翻译更新

## Verification Checklist / 验证清单 / 検証チェックリスト

- [ ] Code builds cleanly with `./gradlew assembleDebug`
- [ ] All unit tests pass with `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest`
- [ ] Added or updated unit tests where applicable
- [ ] String keys are synchronized across EN, ZH, and JA in `strings.xml`
- [ ] Tested on Android device or emulator
